visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Multiple men wearing full-body black spandex suits struggle intensely to hold up a horizontal metal bar. The central figure is in focus, his face contorted with effort, eyes shut, and mouth wide open in a scream against a solid peach-colored background. (2) The shot cuts to a close-up of the man's face as he looks sideways in shock. He then appears in a different scene wearing a grey t-shirt over the suit, standing in a field at sunset with a peaceful smile. (3) The scene shifts back to the struggle, but the background is now a CGI hellscape with swirling fire and red sparks. The man looks extremely distressed and sweaty. (4) Transition to a snowy forest background where digital snow falls heavily. The man continues to hold the bar, appearing frozen and miserable with a blueish tint to the scene. (5) In a modern bathroom, the man in the black suit stands under a shower curtain rod. A giant, oversized real human hand lowers a white towel from above as if the man is miniature; he reacts with extreme terror and screams. (6) A man with a short buzz cut wearing a black t-shirt wipes his hair with a white towel in a brightly lit dressing room. He looks at the towel in confusion, seeing miniature 'men' in suits stuck to the fabric. (7) He holds up orange and red hair care bottles. Scenes follow showing him washing his hair with thick white foam and applying products to his scalp while smiling at the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-intensity orchestral music with dramatic choirs plays during a sequence of strained grunting and loud yelling. The male speaker's voice is high in pitch and intensity, conveying extreme physical exertion and distress. (2) A sharp digital 'ding' sound occurs, marking a transition in mood. The dramatic music instantly cuts to a light, airy piano melody with a moderate tempo. The speaker's voice drops significantly in volume and intensity, sounding surprised and then calm. (3) A loud, low-frequency whoosh sound introduces the sound of crackling fire. The speaker screams 'So hot!' with a very high arousal level and a raspy, strained vocal quality. The BGM becomes a rhythmic, driving electronic beat. (4) A cold wind effect with prominent high-frequency whistling is heard, simulating an outdoor winter environment. The speaker's voice becomes shaky and breathy as he says 'So cold, is it snowing?'. (5) A deep, booming voice with low pitch and high dominance asks a question from an off-screen perspective. This is immediately followed by a high-pitched, panicked scream 'Don't come over!' from the main speaker. (6) The previous background music stops abruptly, leaving a clean, studio-like room-tone background. The speaker talks in a natural, conversational tone about scalp discomfort with clear articulation and a moderate speech rate. (7) Upbeat, high-tempo pop-electronic music starts at a steady BPM. The speaker delivers a fast-paced, enthusiastic promotional monologue. His voice is bright, professional, and well-projected, listing product benefits and a discount code with high clarity and positive valence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage -> Storytelling -> List-based: The video uses a surreal montage to represent scalp issues metaphorically, transitions into a real-life storytelling scenario, and finishes with a structured list of product benefits and a call to action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video utilizes humorous and high-energy metaphors involving men in morphsuits to represent hair/scalp problems like oil and dandruff. It then transitions into a product endorsement for 'Scalp Recovery', demonstrating its use and offering a discount to encourage purchase.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Directly demonstrates the product, provides a discount code '蛇丸寶貝', and explicitly tells the audience to buy it.
